entities.name: Primal Clay
entities.description: A technology discovered by Tawnos and used by Argive in the Brothers' War to make clay statues.

entities.name: Clay Statue
entities.description: Nine-foot artificial bronze-colored creatures made of primal clay that entrap enemies' weapons and limbs.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Discovered primal clay and created the clay statues.

entities.name: Argive
entities.description: Side of the Brothers' War that used clay statues.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War on Dominaria in which clay statues were used.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: Summoned a clay statue over 3000 years later.

entities.name: Gull
entities.description: Greensleeves' brother who found a clay statue on an island.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: Housed clay statues in the Hall of Artifact Creatures.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Activated the statues to defend the academy.

entities.name: K'rrik
entities.description: Phyrexian leader whose forces invaded the academy.

events.summary: Tawnos creates clay statues from primal clay for Argive.
events.quote: The clay statues were created by Tawnos from primal clay.

events.summary: Over 3000 years later Greensleeves summons a clay statue after Gull discovers one on an island.
events.quote: Greensleeves summoned a clay statue after her brother Gull discovered one on an island.

events.summary: Barrin activates the academy's clay statues against K'rrik's invading Phyrexians.
events.quote: Barrin activated them as part of the academy's defenses

relations.quote: The clay statues were created by Tawnos from primal clay.
